language.title: Language
language.description: Choose the display language for this device. Only applies to this device.

direction.title: Text direction
direction.description: Choose left-to-right or right-to-left layout for this device.

touch.title: On screen keyboard
touch.description: Enable or disable on screen keyboard. Only applies to this device.

cache.title: Cache
cache.description: Stores data into browser for faster operations.

printers.title: Default printers
printers.description: Assign printers per user or for this terminal. When system printers are enabled, temp, final, refund, and summary use this device’s assignments. Delivery always uses user or global settings.
printers.useSystemPrinters: Use system printers on this device
printers.useSystemPrintersDescription: When enabled, this browser/terminal uses the system printer assignments below instead of the logged-in user’s printers (except delivery).
printers.systemDescription: Stored in this browser only. Ideal for shared terminals so prints go to nearby printers. Delivery is not included — it stays user or global.
printers.userDescription: Stored per logged-in user. Used when system printers are off, and always for delivery.
printers.loginRequired: Please log in to save printer settings.

printOptions.title: Print options
printOptions.description: Set how many physical copies each print type produces, and how many times temp or final bills can be printed per order before manager approval is required.
printOptions.unlimitedHint: Set max attempts to 0 for unlimited. When the limit is reached, a manager with Override print limit permission must approve.

menus.title: Menu settings
menus.loginRequired: Please log in to save menu settings.

tableSelection.title: Hide table selection from menu
tableSelection.description: Skip table selection and open the menu directly. Only applies to this device. Suitable for takeaway based ordering

autoCheckClose.title: Auto check close
autoCheckClose.description: Automatically close open table checks at closing cycle end time. Delivery orders are excluded. A warning appears 1 minute before close.
autoCheckClose.paymentTypeRequired: Payment type is required when auto close is enabled

closingCycle.title: Closing cycle
closingCycle.description: Configure cycle start and end time. End time can be next day (example: 06:00 to 02:00).

showInclusivePrices.title: Show inclusive prices
showInclusivePrices.description: When enabled, line item amounts on the payment screen, receipts, and item-level reports show the tax-included (gross) price for menu items configured with inclusive tax. The Items/subtotal row stays tax-exclusive, tax is still shown as its own row, and the grand total is unchanged. Exclusive-tax items are not affected. This is display-only and does not change how prices are stored or how tax is calculated.

currencySymbol.title: Currency symbol
currencySymbol.description: Control whether the currency symbol appears next to amounts in the app and on printed receipts. Turning these off shows numbers only (e.g. 1,250 instead of Rs 1,250). This is display-only and does not change stored values.

translateReceipts.title: Translate receipts
translateReceipts.description: When enabled, system labels on printed receipts (bill titles, Invoice#, Table, Tax, Total, kitchen tickets, and summary) use this device's selected language. Custom header and footer text from print settings is not translated.

visibilityConfig.title: Items visibility config
visibilityConfig.description: Update config for this device for which columns for items you want to show or hide. Only applies to this device.
visibilityConfig.enableDishSearch: Enable dish number search on menu
visibilityConfig.showDishNumber: Show dish numbers on menu tiles
visibilityConfig.showTotalsInCart: Show totals for items in cart item
visibilityConfig.showTotalInOrderCard: Show totals for items in order card
visibilityConfig.showGroupsInOrderCard: Show groups for items in order card
visibilityConfig.showQuantityInOrderCard: Show quantity for items in order card
visibilityConfig.showPriceInOrderCard: Show price for items in order card
visibilityConfig.showModifiersInOrderCard: Show modifiers for items in order card
visibilityConfig.showModifierPriceInOrderCard: Show modifier price for items in order card
visibilityConfig.showTotalInPaymentCard: Show totals for items in payment box

inventory.title: Inventory
inventory.description: Ledger cutover and optional advanced tracking. Keep batch/expiry off unless you need them.
inventory.ledgerEnabled: Use inventory ledger (single source of truth)
inventory.ledgerHint: Enable only after running the ledger backfill and confirming reconciliation.
inventory.enablePurchaseDiscounts: Enable purchase discounts in inventory cost
inventory.enablePurchaseTaxes: Enable purchase taxes in inventory cost
inventory.defaultPurchaseTaxBehaviorHint: Non-recoverable tax is capitalized into inventory. Recoverable tax is ignored for valuation.

whatsNew.title: What's New
whatsNew.description: View release notes and recent updates for this app.

sessionSecurity.title: Session security
sessionSecurity.description: Automatically lock or log out this user after a period of inactivity. Choose one action.
sessionSecurity.loginRequired: You must be logged in to save session security settings

autoClockOut.title: Auto clock-out
autoClockOut.description: Automatically clock out the logged-in user when their shift ends and/or at a fixed daily time. Uses the scheduled shift when available, otherwise the user's assigned shift. Applies to all users.
autoClockOut.onDefinedTime: Clock out at a defined time
autoClockOut.triggerRequired: Enable shift end and/or a defined time when auto clock-out is on
